title: MisakaNet Lesson
description: Schema for validating MisakaNet lesson Markdown frontmatter

domain.description: Knowledge domain — should match a domain file in docs/domains/

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. zh, en, ja). Default: zh

evidence_level.description: How well this lesson is evidenced — E0 self-reported, E1 maintainer reviewed, E2 locally reproduced, E3 CI/sandbox verified, E4 reused by another contributor. Missing means E0. See docs/trust-semantics.md

source.description: Normalized provenance channel for this lesson

pr.description: Pull request number or URL when the lesson came from a PR

merged_by.description: GitHub user or maintainer who merged the source PR
